_meta.source: legacy lib/cubeEngine FACE_META (scan fields); generated in T1.17

F.scanHeading: Hold the Front face toward your camera
F.scanInstruction: Start with the green center facing you and the white center on top. Keep all 9 stickers inside the frame.

R.scanHeading: Rotate the whole cube left to show the Right face
R.scanInstruction: Turn the entire cube 90° to the left (do not twist a layer) until the red center faces the camera.

B.scanHeading: Rotate left again to show the Back face
B.scanInstruction: Turn the entire cube another 90° left so the blue center faces the camera, keeping white on top.

L.scanHeading: Rotate left once more for the Left face
L.scanInstruction: Turn the entire cube 90° left so the orange center faces the camera. Hold steady for auto-capture.

U.scanHeading: Return to Front, then tilt the top toward you for the Top face
U.scanInstruction: Turn back to green front, then tilt the top of the whole cube toward the camera so the white center faces straight ahead and the back face ends at the top of the image.
steps: Turn back so the green face looks at the camera
Tilt the top of the whole cube toward the camera
U.rotationHint: Tilt whole cube top toward camera

D.scanHeading: Return to Front, then tilt the bottom toward you for the Bottom face
D.scanInstruction: Turn back to green front, then tilt the bottom of the whole cube toward the camera so the yellow center faces straight ahead and the front face ends at the top of the image.
steps: Turn back so the green face looks at the camera
Tilt the bottom of the whole cube toward the camera
D.rotationHint: Tilt whole cube bottom toward camera
